_comment: Configuration for the tracked verification gates in benchmark/gates/.
recorded_root is the machine the baseline key files were blessed on; it is what lets a
baseline holding absolute paths run on any other checkout without changing one byte of it.
scan_root is the repo-relative tree the gate scans and the prefix its baseline keys carry;
the gate runs from inside that tree, so the engine's own spelling is put back before diffing.
corpus_sha256 pins the Big-8 input bytes, because frozen keys are only an authority for the
input they were made from. pinned_engine_rev is the commit whose output produced the original
keys; a later intentional re-bless is documented in the header of the keys file it describes.
The vendored corpus lives OUTSIDE benchmark/ on purpose: the parity gate scans the whole
benchmark/ tree (scan_root above), so a copy inside benchmark/gates/corpus_big8 leaks 136
third-party keys into it and parity fails 425 vs 561. Directory choice never moves a key --
canon_key collapses every Big-8 file to <corpus_marker>/<leaf> -- only the bytes matter.
Edit this file only together with the baselines it describes.
